review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the complete frozen inputs. REQ-001 and AC-001 through AC-003 match the original PRD. The exact four-file binding scope covers the maintained runtime implementation, declaration, runtime regressions and tsd regressions without requiring unnecessary edits; package.json establishes the existing xo, ava and tsd verification entry point. The source confirms that limitFunction already forwards clearQueue to its single internal limiter but lacks the requested count properties and corresponding return-type declarations. TASK-IMPLEMENT and dependent, independent TASK-VERIFY match the specification, with all required acceptance criteria requiring both relationships. The allowed agents have appropriate delivery roles, availability, auto-assignable membership and supplied active trusted capability claims, including data.change, domain.state, integration.async and integration.consumer; the verifier additionally has testing.verification. The configured reviewer is distinct from the implementer. Ready status, no blocking reasons and the seven evidence stages are consistent with this planning-only case and its empty decision input. No B or C scenario or unresolved DEC-001 is supplied here, so none is inferred. Repository identity, base commit and file fingerprints agree across the supplied records; Gold and preview release fingerprints and model, policy and budget fields match. The documented digest domains and trim-only persistence normalization explain the differing source and PRD digests. Isolation evidence states that Gold precedes every candidate and supplies no historical candidate outputs. This assessment relies on the Service's supplied mechanical digest bindings and recorded capability evidence; I did not recompute digests, execute code or create human attestations.
